VERSION 2 Dataset description === This is the dataset that accompanies the following publication:
Gavard, E., Trardi, Y., Ziegler, J. C. & Chanoine, V. (in revision). A machine learning-based pipeline to decode typical and dyslexic adult readers using fMRI data. NeuroImage: Reports.

VERSION 1 Dataset description ===  This is the dataset that accompanies the following publication:  
Gavard, E., Chanoine, V., Geringswald, F., Anton, J-L., Cavalli, E., & Ziegler, J. C. (2025). Neural Networks for Semantic and Syntactic Prediction and Visuo-Motor Statistical Learning in Adult Readers with and without Dyslexia. Neurobiology of Language. doi: 10.1162/nol.a.8


The dataset contains anatomical and functional MRI images
 of 49 partipants (25 typical and  24 dyslexic readers)

PREDYS 

-- raw_data = BIDS Directory Structure

    -- Subject-level data  --- raw MRI images at 3 T

    	sub-{id}/anat   --- anatomical
    	sub-{id}/dwi    --- diffusion-weighted
    	sub-{id}/fmap   --- functional
    	sub-{id}/funct  --- fieldmap

    -- sourcedata       ---  experimental files during scanning

-- code                       --- code for the publication on Machine Learning 
-- derivatives            --- preprocessed data for the publication on Machine Learning
